def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(H):
      for c in range(W):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if not col or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and grid[yy][xx]==col and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells); c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
        # A zero is a hole when it is not connected to the bbox edge through zeros.
        occ=set(cells); outside=set(); st=[]
        for yy in range(r0,r1+1):
          for xx in range(c0,c1+1):
            if (yy in (r0,r1) or xx in (c0,c1)) and (yy,xx) not in occ:
              outside.add((yy,xx)); st.append((yy,xx))
        while st:
          yy,xx=st.pop()
          for y2,x2 in ((yy-1,xx),(yy+1,xx),(yy,xx-1),(yy,xx+1)):
            if r0<=y2<=r1 and c0<=x2<=c1 and (y2,x2) not in occ and (y2,x2) not in outside:
              outside.add((y2,x2)); st.append((y2,x2))
        hole=any((yy,xx) not in occ and (yy,xx) not in outside for yy in range(r0,r1+1) for xx in range(c0,c1+1))
        objs.append({'cells':cells,'hole':hole,'minr':r0,'maxr':r1})
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for hole in (True,False):
      these=[o for o in objs if o['hole']==hole]
      these.sort(key=lambda o: o['minr'] if hole else -o['maxr'])
      placed=[]
      for o in these:
        cells=o['cells']; dr=-1 if hole else 1
        while True:
          shifted=[(y+dr,x) for y,x in cells]
          if any(y<0 or y>=H for y,x in shifted): break
          if any((y,x) in placed for y,x in shifted): break
          cells=shifted
        for y,x in cells:
          out[y][x]=grid[o['cells'][0][0]][o['cells'][0][1]]
          placed.append((y,x))
    return out

src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            stack = [(r, c)]
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        cells.append((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            occupied = set(cells)
            outside, stack = set(), []
            for y in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                for x in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                    if (y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)) and (y, x) not in occupied:
                        outside.add((y, x))
                        stack.append((y, x))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if r0 <= yy <= r1 and c0 <= xx <= c1 and (yy, xx) not in occupied and (yy, xx) not in outside:
                        outside.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            has_hole = any((y, x) not in occupied and (y, x) not in outside
                           for y in range(r0, r1 + 1) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1))
            objects.append({'cells': cells, 'hole': has_hole, 'color': color,
                            'top': r0, 'bottom': r1})

    result = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for has_hole in (True, False):
        group = [obj for obj in objects if obj['hole'] == has_hole]
        group.sort(key=lambda obj: obj['top'] if has_hole else -obj['bottom'])
        placed = set()
        step = -1 if has_hole else 1
        for obj in group:
            cells = obj['cells']
            while True:
                shifted = [(y + step, x) for y, x in cells]
                if any(y < 0 or y >= h for y, x in shifted) or any(cell in placed for cell in shifted):
                    break
                cells = shifted
            for y, x in cells:
                result[y][x] = obj['color']
                placed.add((y, x))
    return result
'''
